services.name: Single Kayak
services.desc: Kayaking in and around the Santa Barbara Harbor is an experience not to be missed. Explore some of the gorgeous yachts in the harbor, then paddle out of the harbor entrance, where you’ll experience sunbathing sea lions, numerous birds, and occasional dolphins. Next, kayak over and experience Santa Barbara’s famous Stearns Wharf from the water. If you still have energy, you can continue kayaking along the coast and past the boat anchorage and East Beach before returning to the harbor for a yummy lunch or happy hour and a cold beverage. Choose from group or private kayaking tours, or head out on your own and explore the hidden sights of the Santa Barbara coastline. Kayaking and paddleboarding

services.name: SUP Rentals
services.desc: The Santa Barbara Sailing Center has been introducing people to the lifestyle and sport of sailing since 1967. Since then, we have grown to include an assortment of unique on-the-water experiences, including public cruises and boat rides, yacht charters, kayaking, and stand-up paddleboarding adventures. services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: Enjoy an easy afternoon sail aboard a stable Capri 22’! Please note: sailing experience is required in addition to passing our small boat sailing quiz in person on the day of your rental. Known for its sweet sailing performance in nearly all conditions, the Catalina Capri 22′ has been winning over sailors since its introduction. The Capri 22 is more comfortable, safer at sea, and easier to maintain than other boats in its class. Its striking deck profile is flared across the stern and its wide cockpit curves are comfortable for crew both during and after sailing. It is now offered with an electric motor. Please note that reservations are only available for day sail rentals. All hourly

services.name: Day Sail
services.desc: For those interested in advancing through the program, we offer course packages. These packages include complimentary sail time, certification fees, materials, and club membership. Scheduling is flexible, and the school director will work with your preferred dates and availability. Choosing the Santa Barbara Sailing Center for your American Sailing Association (ASA) certification offers an unparalleled educational experience, starting with its unique location and venue. When deciding where to learn to sail, the size and layout of a harbor play a major role in your overall comfort and focus.
